spans.s: गज् (I) vi. 1P (pp. गजित) 1. To roar, जगजुर्गजाः Bt.xiv.5; 2. to be drunk, to be confused or inebriated.
गज् (II) vi. 1P (pres. गंजति) To sound in a particular way.
गज m. 1. An elephant, नगजा न गजा दयिता दयिताः Bt.x.9; 2. the number ‘eight’; 3. a measure of length (thus defined- साधारणनरांगुल्या त्रिंशदंगुलको गजः); 4. a demon killed by Śiva.
गज-अग्रणी m. 1. the most excellent among elephants; 2. an epithet of ऐरावत, the elephant of Indra.
गज-अधिपति m. the prince of elephants, a noble elephant.
गज-अध्यक्ष m. a superintendent of elephants.
गज-अपसद m. a common or low-born elephant.
गज-अशन (I) m. the religious fig tree.
गज-अशन (II) n. the root of a lotus.
गज-अरि m. 1. a lion; 2. Śiva, who killed the demon गज.
गज-आजीव m. one who gets his livelihood by elephants, an elephant-driver.
गज-आनन, -आस्य m. a name of Gaṇeśa.
गज-आनन, -आस्य m. a name of Gaṇeśa.
गज-आयुर्वेद m. science of the treatment of elephants.
गज-आरोह m. elephant-driver.
गज-आह्व, -आह्वय n. a name of Hastināpura.
गज-आह्व, -आह्वय n. a name of Hastināpura.
गज-इंद्र m. 1. an excellent elephant, किं रुष्टासि गजेंद्रमंदगमने Sr.
; 2. Airāvata, Indra’s elephant.
गज-इंद्र˚कर्ण m. an epithet of Śiva.
गज-कंद m. a large esculent root.
गज-कूर्माशिन् m. a name of Gaṇeśa.
गज-गति f. 1. a stately gait like that of an elephant; 2. a woman with such a gait.
गज-गामिनी f. woman with a stately elephant-like gait.
गज-ढक्का f. a kettle-drum carried on the back of an elephant.
गज-ता f. a multitude of elephants.
गज-दघ्न, -द्वयस a. high or tall as an elephant.
गज-दघ्न, -द्वयस a. high or tall as an elephant.
गज-दंत m. 1. an elephant’s tusk; 2. an epithet of Gaṇeśa; 3. ivory; 4. a peg, a pin projecting from a wall.
गज-दंत˚मय a. made of ivory.
गज-दान n. 1. the liquid exuding from the temples of an elephant; 2. gift of an elephant.
गज-नासा f. the trunk of an elephant.
गज-पति m. 1. an excellent elephant; 2. a very tall elephant, गजपतिद्वयसीरपि हैमनस्तुहिनयन् सरितः पृषतांपतिः Sis.vi.55.
गज-पुंगव m. a large and excellent elephant, गजपुंगवंस्तु धीरं विलोकयति चाटुशतैश्च भुंक्ते Bhartr.ii.31.
गज-पुर n. name of Hastināpura.
गज-बंधनी, -बंधिनी f. a stable for elephants.
गज-बंधनी, -बंधिनी f. a stable for elephants.
गज-भक्षक m. the sacred fig tree.
गज-मंडन n. the ornaments with which an elephant is decorated, especially the coloured lines on his head.
गज-मंडलिका, -मंडली f. a ring or circle of elephants.
गज-मंडलिका, -मंडली f. a ring or circle of elephants.
गज-माचल m. a lion.
गज-मुक्ता f. a pearl supposed to be found in the projections on the forehead of an elephant.
गज-मौक्तिक n. a pearl supposed to be found in the projections on the forehead of an elephant.
गज-मुख, -वक्त्र, -वदन m. a name of Gaṇeśa.
गज-मुख, -वक्त्र, -वदन m. a name of Gaṇeśa.
गज-मुख, -वक्त्र, -वदन m. a name of Gaṇeśa.
गज-मोटन m. a lion.
गज-यूथ m. a herd of elephants, R.ix.71.
गज-योधिन् a. fighting on an elephant.
गज-राज m. a noble elephant.
गज-वत् a. having elephants, R.ix.10.
गज-व्रज m. a troop of elephants.
गज-शिक्षा f. the science of elephants.
गज-साह्वय n. a name of Hastināpura.

गज-स्नान n. 1. bathing of an elephant (lit.); 2. vain or unproductive efforts resembling the ablution of elephants which, after squirting water over their bodies end by throwing dirt and rubbish (fig.), e.g. (हस्तिस्नानमिव क्रिया Hit.i.
गाजर n. A carrot.
